item.title: As quirky Switch 2 life sim Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream gets its big reveal, Nintendo makes good on decade-old same-sex relationship promise
item.description: Nintendo's delightfully quirky Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream has been given the full reveal treatment ahead of its Switch and Switch 2 release on 16th April.
